purpose: Joint reconstruction for the paper (Section 6.4): Example 1 (straight junction), Setting 2, KL coefficients and plateau values c_p, c_n inferred together, with uniform plateau priors. Stage A uses the paper's intervals, Stage B intervals twice as wide with the same centres (Reviewer 1 item 5: dependence of the plateau posterior on the prior support; Reviewer 2: posterior/prior sd of the plateaus; Reviewer 1 item 1: chains, R-hat, bulk and tail ESS, divergences, cost). NUTS only. Supersedes production_joint_v1 (committed 28 Oct 2026, never run). Declared and frozen before the runs; a change of any setting requires a new manifest id and output tag.

prior.plateau_prior: c_p ~ U(a_p, b_p), c_n ~ U(a_n, b_n), independent of z and of each other
prior.sampled_coordinates: theta = (z, r_p, r_n), c = a + (b - a) S(r) with the logistic S, and the log-Jacobian term -log S'(r_p) - log S'(r_n) in the potential (posterior.py, Posterior.potential with jacobian=True)

model.plateau_bounds_note: the paper's intervals (config.py CP_BOUNDS, CN_BOUNDS), used by Stage A; Stage B overrides them (twice as wide, same centres)

true_values.depth_note: lowest crossing of c = 0 on x = 0.5 of the true field on the inversion mesh

data.note: existing observation files; their bytes are tracked in git and must not be regenerated

chains.seed_rule: chain c of a stage uses the stage seed + c: Stage A 100-103, Stage B 200-203
chains.initialisation_note: each chain starts from an independent prior draw: z ~ N(0, I), r_p, r_n ~ Logistic(0, 1), i.e. c_p and c_n uniform on the stage's intervals

nuts.target_rationale: User decision, 28 Oct 2026, replacing the rule of production_v1_t095 ('the primary target is used for Example 2 and the joint reconstruction', i.e. 0.95). Reason: there is no pCN comparison in the joint setting, and in Example 2 target 0.99 removed the divergences (0 against 12 at 0.95) and was more efficient than 0.95 (2.6x per PDE solve for the retained draws, 2.2x including warm-up; report Section 13). For the record: in Example 1, Setting 1 the order was reversed (0.95 more efficient; 26 divergences at 0.95, 21 at 0.99; report Section 12).

pcn.note: not used: no pCN run in the joint setting

diagnostics.monitored: all KL coefficients, c_p, c_n and the junction depth d (lowest crossing of c = 0 on x = 0.5)
diagnostics.undefined: an undefined R-hat or ESS of any monitored quantity means not passed
diagnostics.checkpoints: retrospective, on prefixes of the capped runs; costs from per-draw records; first pass reported with persistence, or 'not reached within the cap'

divergences.follow_up_rule: more than 0.5 % of the retained draws, or at least 3 divergences with 75 % or more in one chain
divergences.handling: report count, chain and location; keep the output; investigate the states; never change settings silently

timing.batches: one four-chain sampler batch at a time, no other heavy jobs on the machine
reported: aggregate worker time (sum over chains), sampling only and including warm-up
actual batch elapsed time from launch to the last chain end (epoch timestamps)
timing.excluded_from_sampler_timers: model construction and KL set-up (included in the batch elapsed time)

failure_handling: outputs are validated with check_run.py --production; an invalid output stops the driver and is kept for inspection; a valid run that fails the diagnostics or needs divergence follow-up is kept and flagged, never silently rerun with other settings
scope: Example 1, unknown plateaus (Setting 2): stages joint_A (c_p ~ U(-2.5, -1.5), c_n ~ U(0.5, 1.5)) and joint_B (c_p ~ U(-3, -1), c_n ~ U(0, 2)), NUTS at target acceptance 0.99, run one after another.

predeclared.reporting: for each stage: diagnostics over all monitored quantities; divergences per chain with location; step sizes, tree depth, acceptance statistic; cost (gradients, PDE and forward-equivalent solves, retained and total, wall-clock time, minimum ESS per 10^3 forward-equivalent solves and per wall-clock second); RE and SSIM of the posterior mean; posterior of c_p, c_n, d (mean, sd, 5/50/95 % quantiles with MCSE, coverage of the truth by the 90 % interval); posterior/prior sd and mass near the bounds of c_p, c_n; for Stage B the mass outside the paper's intervals; corr(c_p, d), corr(c_n, d), corr(c_p, c_n); changes from A to B in combined MCSE
predeclared.rules: the convergence thresholds and the divergence follow-up rule of production_v1 apply unchanged
predeclared.not_met: a stage that does not meet the criteria at 2000 draws per chain is reported as not met; it is not extended
predeclared.divergences: divergences are reported with count, chain and location; there is no automatic rerun
predeclared.widening: if Stage B also accumulates at its bounds, that is reported as the result; there are no further widenings
predeclared.changes: no reruns, extensions or setting changes after seeing the results without the user's approval
